as_told.title: Jake Barber's team contracted to retrieve downed craft

plain: A man named Jake Barber says he belonged to a team that recovered crashed craft with help from "psionic assets", people said to have psychic abilities who could mentally call such craft down. Jesse Michels first tells it from a story by the journalist Ross Coulthart on the US news channel NewsNation, describing "people psychically calling in exotic material." Later he adds Barber's term "P3s", people with a psionic predisposition who "act as the bridge". A researcher who goes by UAPGerb says Barber testified that these abilities can "forcefully land craft or bring them down." A witness named Michael Herrera adds that Barber's team was hired to pick up the downed vehicles and move them to a facility, which would mean the craft can be reached and recovered through the mind.
